sovereign_country.strategic_role: 支持全中文章程、传统华人客群离岸家族信托常驻地

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Commercial CGI Visual Effects and 3D Character Animation

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act 1987 (as amended), ss. 4 (incorporation), 10 (memorandum and articles), 12 (directors), 24 (registered office and agent)
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Samoa International Finance Authority (SIFA) - International Companies Registry
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Application for Incorporation of an International Company on Form IC-1 together with the Memorandum and Articles of Association
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital; authorized capital may be stated in any currency. No escrow account or capital deposit is required at incorporation.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED that the Company be incorporated under the International Companies Act 1987, adopting the Memorandum and Articles as filed. RESOLVED that the Company allot one ordinary share to the subscriber at par, fully paid and recorded in the share register, and that no shares be offered to the public in Samoa. RESOLVED that the registered office be at the licensed registered agent's office in Apia, Samoa. RESOLVED that [Director] be appointed Director and [Secretary] be appointed Secretary, each to serve until removed. RESOLVED that the Director may open bank accounts, engage payment providers including Wise and SWIFT, and approve contracts for commercial 3D animation and VFX production.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Samoa International Finance Authority (SIFA), International Companies Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a name reservation request online or in writing, listing at least one preferred name. SIFA will check the proposed name against the register of existing international companies and issue a clearance letter. The prescribed search and reservation fee must be paid before the search is conducted.
required_dossiers: Proposed name and Chinese character equivalent, if any
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected as identical or confusingly similar to an existing name, submit up to three alternative names within 10 business days. A written appeal may be made to the Registrar for further review.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation and Execution of Memorandum and Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed registered agent in Samoa; notarization before a Samoan Notary Public as required
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The subscribers must prepare and execute the Memorandum and Articles of Association in accordance with the International Companies Act 1987. The constitutional documents must state the company name, registered office, authorized share capital, and objects. Signature pages must be notarized where the registered agent or bank requires certification.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the constitutional documents contain provisions inconsistent with the Act, the registered agent may require rectification before filing. Amend the relevant clauses and re-execute signature pages as directed.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Appointment of Registered Agent and Registered Office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Engage a licensed registered agent to maintain the registered office in Apia, Samoa. Execute a registered office consent letter and agent engagement agreement. The registered agent will accept service of process and statutory notices. No physical business premises in Samoa is required for the International Company if its operations remain offshore.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registered agent withdraws consent, the company has 30 days to appoint a substitute licensed agent and file a notice of change with the Registrar.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Filing of Incorporation Application and Payment of Statutory Fee
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: SIFA - International Companies Registry (online lodgement or physical filing)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the Form IC-1 application for incorporation together with the constitutional documents, consents of first directors, and registered agent consent. Pay the prescribed government fee by wire or bank transfer. Ensure the filing is designated as an International Company so that Tax Exempt Zone status applies.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar issues a requisition, respond within 14 days with amended documents. Failure to cure the requisition may cause the application to be deemed abandoned and fees may be forfeited, requiring a fresh filing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Certificate Issuance, Corporate Records and Post-Incorporation Formalities
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: SIFA - International Companies Registry / Samoa International Finance Authority
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon approval, the Registrar issues a Certificate of Incorporation and filed copies of the constitutional documents. Convene the first board meeting to adopt the pro-forma board resolution, open a corporate bank account, and approve the registered agent. Maintain the share register and statutory records at the registered office in Samoa.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the certificate contains an administrative error, apply in writing for correction within 30 days. The Registrar may issue an amended certificate without republication.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not applicable for offshore International Company; for any physical studio in Samoa, the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL) is the relevant authority.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: No operating licence required for International Company performing offshore CGI/3D animation; a Domestic Business Licence would apply only if selling goods or services to the Samoa local market.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministry of Natural Resources and Environment (MNRE) of Samoa
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt - digital CGI/3D animation and VFX production is a computer-based service with no physical manufacturing or discharge; it does not appear in the mandatory EIA trigger list under Samoan planning and environmental regulations.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No wastewater, VOC, or hazardous waste thresholds apply to pure digital operations. If a physical studio is established, general environmental duties under MNRE regulations require control of noise, dust, and waste; no chemical emissions are expected from animation workstations.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: No fire safety or structural clearance is required for a purely offshore International Company. If a physical office or studio is opened in Samoa, obtain a Fire Safety Certificate from the Samoa Fire and Emergency Services Authority and comply with the Occupational Safety and Health Act 2004, including workplace inspection and structural load clearance.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Ministry for Revenue (MFR), Samoa — sole national tax authority under the Tax Administration Act 2016, administering income tax, Value Added Goods and Services Tax (VAGST), and excise; online taxpayer portal: MFR e-Services at https://www.mfr.gov.ws; head office: Level 2, FMFMII Building, Sogi, Apia, Samoa.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Step 1: Incorporate the International Company (IC) with the Registrar of International Companies, Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL), by filing the company constitution, registered office consent, and director/shareholder particulars under the International Companies Act 1987; standard turnaround 1–3 business days. Step 2: Receive the Certificate of Incorporation bearing the IC registration number. Step 3: Apply to the Ministry for Revenue for a Taxpayer Identification Number (TIN) via the MFR e-Services portal or in person, submitting the Certificate of Incorporation, identification of directors and beneficial owners, and registered office details; TIN issuance typically takes 1–5 business days and is required to open the WS_IC's Wise B2B or SWIFT banking facilities. Step 4: No VAGST registration is required for an IC conducting exclusively offshore business because the IC is outside the Samoan indirect tax nexus and is statutorily exempt under s.111 of the International Companies Act 1987. Step 5: If the IC voluntarily elects VAGST registration to recover input tax on any local procurement, a VAGST registration application must be filed with MFR; registration is mandatory only where taxable turnover actually sourced in Samoa reaches the statutory threshold.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Tax_Exempt_Zone — a Samoa International Company is exempt from income tax, capital gains tax, withholding tax, and stamp duty on all income and transactions carried on outside Samoa by operation of s.111 of the International Companies Act 1987; the exemption is absolute, requires no election, and applies automatically upon incorporation, provided the IC refrains from trading with Samoa residents except under the limited statutory exceptions.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Samoa has no U.S.-style check-the-box regime and has not enacted OECD hybrid mismatch election rules. The IC tax-exempt classification is mandatory and non-elective. Available elections: (i) voluntary VAGST registration under the VAGST Act 1992 for a person making exclusively zero-rated exported supplies, enabling input-credit recovery; (ii) conversion or continuation election under the International Companies Act 1987 to redomicile the IC into or out of Samoa, or conversion into a local company under the Companies Act 2006, which would subject the entity to ordinary Samoan domestic taxation; (iii) no annual filing is required to maintain the s.111 exemption.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Goods and Services Tax (VAGST) imposed under the Value Added Goods and Services Tax Act 1992, as amended by the VAGST Amendment Act 2016 and administered under the Tax Administration Act 2016.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: WST 200,000 (Samoan Tala) annual taxable turnover sourced in Samoa; an International Company supplying exclusively offshore export services is outside the VAGST nexus and is not required to register regardless of turnover volume.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No real-time fiscal clearance, government API e-invoicing, or digital stamping mandate is currently in force in Samoa. VAGST-registered suppliers must issue serially numbered tax invoices stating VAGST separately, retain records in electronic or paper form, and file returns through the MFR e-Services portal; there is no third-party clearance platform or fiscal device integration requirement.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: A supply of services is zero-rated under the VAGST Act 1992 where the recipient is a non-resident of Samoa and is outside Samoa at the time of supply and the services are not performed for or supplied to a person in Samoa. The WS_IC's commercial 3D animation and VFX deliverables (rendered footage, CGI character animation assets, visual effects production services, and licence rights) supplied to overseas studios, broadcasters, and platforms qualify as exported services. Independently, s.111 of the International Companies Act 1987 exempts the IC from all Samoan taxation on offshore income, so no VAGST is chargeable even outside the strict zero-rating analysis; voluntary VAGST registration would permit refund of input tax on local expenses attributable to such exported supplies.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration together with an itemized Airway Bill or Bill of Lading where physical media or deliverables are shipped
Signed service or production agreement identifying the non-resident client, scope of 3D animation/VFX deliverables, and licence territory
Commercial invoice referencing the applicable contract and expressly stating that the supply is exported and zero-rated
Inward Remittance Certificate or SWIFT / Wise B2B payment confirmation evidencing foreign-currency receipt from the non-resident client
Digital delivery log, FTP/cloud transfer manifest, or delivery receipt evidencing cross-border transmission of animation files where no physical goods are exported
Client attestation of non-residence (Certificate of Non-Residence) where the client is a foreign affiliate, co-producer, or production venture
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: MFR audit practice applies a 180-day commercial benchmark for repatriation of export proceeds; Samoa imposes no statutory foreign-exchange deadline, but failure to evidence timely inward remittance may trigger an export zero-rating review and denial of input-credit refunds. Under the Tax Administration Act 2016, incorrect zero-rating claims or false export documentation attract a shortfall penalty of up to 150% of the tax avoided, plus statutory interest at the prescribed annual rate from the date the tax should have been paid; assessments may be reopened for up to 5 years (7 years in cases of fraud), and criminal prosecution may result in fines and imprisonment for knowingly false declarations. For a statutory International Company, the s.111 exemption is the operative shield, and clawback exposure is limited to the narrow circumstance of the IC engaging in non-exempt onshore Samoan activity.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Central Bank of Samoa (Faletupe Tutotonu o Samoa / CBS), administering the Exchange Control Act 1976 and the Exchange Control Regulations 1982, and licensing commercial banks under the Financial Institutions Act 1996; offshore International Companies (ICs) are incorporated under the International Companies Act 2016 administered by the Samoa International Finance Authority (SIFA).
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Samoan Tala (WST) is a managed-float currency without free offshore convertibility; all lawful conversions must be executed through a CBS-licensed authorized dealer. Current-account payments are processed on documented commercial justification, whereas capital-account transactions (equity injections, shareholder loans, and profit remittances) require prior CBS approval through prescribed Exchange Control forms. A Samoa International Company is non-resident and tax-exempt, and genuine offshore transactions fall outside the domestic exchange-control perimeter; however, any credit to an onshore WST account or use of a local non-resident account triggers CBS forms and reporting. Profit remittance by onshore trading entities is subject to Form EC/8, tax clearance, audited financial statements, and source-funds verification; no offshore non-deliverable forward (NDF) market exists for WST.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Domestic resident exporters must repatriate foreign-currency service or goods proceeds to Samoa within 30 days of receipt and surrender them to an authorized dealer, reflecting a 100% statutory conversion ratio, unless CBS grants an External (Foreign Currency) Account concession, in which case retention may be 100% against quarterly FX returns. A Samoa International Company maintaining an approved non-resident/offshore account is not subject to onshore surrender; if export-style service proceeds are credited to a resident WST account, the 30-day repatriation and mandatory conversion obligation is triggered unless formally waived by CBS.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account (External Foreign Currency Account)

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Bank of South Pacific (BSP) Samoa Limited

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low for in-country regulated banking. Samoa has no digital EMI licensing framework, and Wise B2B is not locally licensed or directly available to a WS-domiciled IC because Samoa is not a supported Wise Business jurisdiction and no WST balance or local settlement access exists. Legal constraint: the Financial Institutions Act 1996 reserves deposit-taking for licensed banks, and the Exchange Control Act 1976 requires CBS-authorized dealers for Samoa-channeled FX. Wise B2B may be used only as an outbound disbursement rail through a supported-jurisdiction sub-entity, with underlying CBS and substance approvals where applicable.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: No statutory in-person mandate exists, but CBS-licensed banks generally require at least one director or UBO signatory to attend a physical KYC interview at a branch or to complete a recorded remote video KYC interview subject to senior compliance pre-approval. All corporate documents must be notarized and apostilled, including the Certificate of Incorporation (International Company), Certificate of Incumbency, UBO declaration, charter, and board resolutions. ANZ and BSP accept remote onboarding on a case-by-case basis.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Offshore International Company with opaque non-resident UBO structure
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: SIFA certificate of incorporation and good standing; current Certificate of Incumbency disclosing natural-person UBOs above statutory thresholds; register of directors and shareholders; notarized charter; board resolution appointing account signatories.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: UBO resident in a high-risk, sanctioned, or non-cooperative jurisdiction
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: PEP and sanctions screening clearance; sworn source-of-wealth affidavit; 6 to 12 months of personal bank statements; certified bank reference from the UBO's principal financial institution; corporate group structure chart.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Intangible cross-border services (VFX and 3D animation) without physical substance in Samoa
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Executed client production contracts; statements of work; itemized invoices; delivery and version logs; IP assignment deeds; substance memorandum and any Economic Substance compliance evidence, including Samoa board and meeting records.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Remote onboarding without any in-person director appearance
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Apostilled and notarized passports of all directors and UBOs; recorded video KYC interview with a compliance officer; certified true copies of all corporate documents; independent professional reference from a licensed lawyer or accountant; bank-to-bank reference from the shareholder's bank.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: SWIFT MT103 from the shareholder's home bank to the IC's account at a CBS-licensed authorized dealer. Field 70 must cite the BPM6 purpose code (e.g., E510 Direct Investment-Equity Capital or L2 Shareholder Loan), the WS_IC entity identifier, and the SIFA registration reference; the receiving bank must obtain CBS Exchange Control Form EC/1 or non-resident account credit approval before ledger credit. The verification packet includes the board resolution authorizing capital issuance, subscription agreement, CBS approval, and SIFA annual return confirmation.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: SWIFT MT103 with field 70 citing invoice and contract numbers for service-based animation and VFX settlements and subcontractor payments; Wise B2B API multi-currency payouts for low-value dispersed vendor disbursements in supported jurisdictions; Commercial Letters of Credit (UCP 600) only for physical merchandise or licensed goods ancillary to the animation business; all onshore-routed outflows require CBS Form EC/2 or EC/4 together with underlying contract evidence.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Onshore deliverable forward contracts (WST/USD or WST/EUR) with a CBS-licensed authorized dealer, supported by documented underlying trade or service exposure
Cross-currency swaps (WST against major FX) with ad hoc Central Bank of Samoa approval for long-term capital-mismatch hedging
Spot FX conversions executed through authorized dealers for operational liquidity management

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Return for International Company (Section 225, International Companies Act 1987)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Samoa Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL), Registrar of International Companies
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 30 days after the anniversary of incorporation each year; annual government fee payable concurrently
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late payment accrues interest at 10% per annum on the unpaid fee; failure to deliver the Annual Return or pay the fee for three months authorizes the Registrar to strike the company off the International Companies Register administratively, with forfeiture of assets to the State

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Government License Fee Renewal (International Companies (Fees) Regulations 2009)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually before the anniversary of incorporation; paid together with the Annual Return
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Penalty interest of 10% per annum applies to overdue amounts; non-payment for three months triggers administrative strike-off and vesting of company assets in the Government of Samoa

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Economic Substance Annual Declaration (International Companies (Economic Substance) Act 2021)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 12 months following the end of each financial year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: False or omitted declarations attract penalties of up to WST 100,000; continued non-compliance may lead to withdrawal of tax-exempt status, monetary penalties per director, and strike-off proceedings

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No compulsory statutory audit applies to Samoa International Companies; an independent auditor must be appointed only upon a demand by shareholders holding at least 10% of voting rights or by creditors holding at least 10% of the aggregate debt (Sections 129-130, International Companies Act 1987).
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Section 144 of the International Companies Act 1987 requires accounting records sufficient to explain transactions and to disclose the financial position with reasonable accuracy; financial statements, if voluntarily prepared, are commonly compiled under IFRS or other internationally recognized standards and are not filed with the Registrar.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The International Companies Act 1987 requires the Register of Members and Register of Directors to be maintained at the Samoa registered office and updated within 14 days of any transfer or change in directors; no separate annual UBO confirmation filing is imposed on low-risk, non-licensed international companies; the Annual Return serves as the periodic confirmation of registered particulars.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 750 - USD 1,500 per annum (licensed registered agent including registered office and company secretarial maintenance)
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 1,500 - USD 3,500 (voluntary independent audit; not statutorily required for an exempt International Company)

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% for an International Company (IC) under s. 217, International Companies Act 1987 (Samoa); statutory headline CIT for a standard Samoa resident company is 27%
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Absolute exemption from Samoa income tax, capital gains tax, dividend/distribution tax and stamp duty. ICs pay only registration and annual government fees to the Registrar of International Companies. No imputation or branch tax concept applies to ICs. Loss carry-forward relief is irrelevant because the IC has no assessable income.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: No CIT return is issued to, or required from, an exempt International Company. A confirmatory 'nil assessment' letter is obtainable from the Samoa Ministry of Revenue (Inland Revenue) on request.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Not applicable (annual confirmation only if requested)
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Not applicable; no statutory CIT deadline applies to the IC

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Confirmation that income of the IC is exempt under s. 217 ICA 1987
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident shareholders should not file a Samoa CIT return; request a Certificate of Exemption / Tax Residency Certificate from the Ministry of Revenue for presentation to foreign tax authorities

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Nil where the IC remains compliant with the International Companies Act and the annual fee regime

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Annual Return in the prescribed form under the International Companies Act 1987 (Regulations), filed electronically through the Samoa e-Registry portal operated by the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL)
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within 30 days after each anniversary of incorporation; annual government fee payable on the incorporation anniversary

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Exact company name, registration number and date of incorporation
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Name must match the Certificate of Incorporation verbatim; verify registration against the e-Registry prior to filing

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Physical Samoa registered office address and licensed registered agent details
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A licensed resident agent with a physical Apia office is mandatory in all cases; a P.O. Box alone is insufficient

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Full legal name, nationality, residential address and date of birth of each director
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Nominee or corporate directors are permitted; the beneficial controller should be recorded accurately where CRS demands disclosure

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Name, address, class and number of shares of each shareholder; total issued capital
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Register all beneficial holders to avoid false-declaration liability; bearer share positions must be disclosed as custodied

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration that the IC has not conducted business with Samoa residents, owns no Samoa land (except an office lease) and has not offered shares to the Samoa public
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A positive answer to any domestic-activity item jeopardizes the s. 217 exemption and triggers full Samoa CIT and withholding tax exposure

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Signature of director, company secretary or registered agent
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: False or recklessly inaccurate certification exposes the signatory to criminal penalty and personal liability

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Regulation-prescribed late filing fee plus a schedule of monthly surcharges on unpaid annual government fees; persistent non-compliance leads to striking-off, deregistration and restoration costs that directors must settle personally

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Annual Government Fee schedule - invoiced via the Samoa e-Registry and paid to the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: On or before each anniversary of incorporation

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Fixed annual fee by share capital band prescribed under the International Companies (Fees) Regulations
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Pay through the registered agent; retain the treasury receipt as evidence of good standing

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Compounding late fee, interest and automatic suspension of IC good-standing status if unpaid; prolonged default triggers deregistration

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% - dividends, distributions and returns of capital paid by a Samoa IC are exempt from every form of Samoa tax under s. 217(2) ICA 1987. By contrast, dividends paid by a standard Samoa resident company to a non-resident attract 15% final withholding tax
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: No treaty relief is needed at source because the IC distribution carries zero Samoa withholding tax. Documentary protocol: (1) request a Certificate of Exemption / Tax Residency Certificate from the Samoa Ministry of Revenue confirming IC status; (2) attach the Certificate to the shareholder's home-country foreign tax credit claim; (3) where the shareholder is in a CRS/EOIR jurisdiction, its tax authority will automatically receive the IC's beneficial ownership data under the Multilateral Convention on Mutual Administrative Assistance - token offshore privacy is unavailable. Samoa's DTA network is minimal (e.g., New Zealand); no DTA with China, Hong Kong or Taiwan is in force
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Royalties and interest paid by an IC to foreign licensors or lenders are not subject to Samoa withholding because the IC is a tax-exempt, non-assessable payer. Where a taxable Samoa resident comparator makes such payments, statutory withholding is 15% for both royalties and interest; treaty rates depend on the very limited Samoa DTA network

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Not applicable to the IC: no local transfer pricing documentation is filed in Samoa because the IC has no assessable income. Samoa Income Tax Act 2012 ss. 66-69 apply the arm's length standard and a 3:1 debt-equity thin-capitalization ceiling to taxable residents but publish no Local File or Master File monetary thresholds. As best practice, the IC should retain transfer pricing and contract documentation in English to defend intercompany animation and 3D IP invoices in the shareholder's tax jurisdiction
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: No Economic Substance Regulations (ESR) modelled on BVI or Cayman apply in Samoa; the IC exemption does not condition on local staffing or physical presence. However, the International Companies Act mandates a licensed resident agent and registered office, and the 2023 OECD/EU transparency standards mean an IC without genuine commercial substance - real animation contracts, production files, cash-flow reconciliation and board oversight - will be recharacterized in the home jurisdiction as a controlled foreign company or a sham. The practical substance requirement therefore equals the head-office and record-keeping discipline of the commercial buyer

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Parking commercial 3D animation profits earned from China, Taiwan or Hong Kong clients inside the Samoa IC without declaring the economic owner; backdating invoices; inflating deductible license fees for animation IP to strip income
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Loss of the s. 217 exemption if any domestic Samoa activity is admitted; in the shareholder's jurisdiction - full tax re-assessment, understatement penalties up to 100-200%, interest compounding and criminal fines
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Anti-avoidance rules and fraudulent-trading doctrines pierce the corporate veil: directors are jointly and severally liable for the hidden profit pool; court-ordered travel bans and asset freezes; imprisonment of up to 7 years is available in charging jurisdictions

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company and False Business Substance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Certifying in the annual return that the IC has no trading activity while the IC in fact conducts a substantial animation production and licensing business; misrepresenting the existence of employees, offices or client contracts
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Samoa: deregistration and striking-off, restoration only by court order, payment of all arrears plus legal costs; the IC loses good-standing status and its Wise or bank accounts are frozen
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Director disqualification orders; the certifying officer faces criminal liability for false declaration; home-country CFC rules attribute the entire undistributed income to the controlling shareholder at full marginal rates

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Anti-Money Laundering / Counter Financing of Terrorism
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Receiving Wise B2B or SWIFT deposits without maintaining client due diligence, source-of-funds documentation, beneficial ownership records, or without responding to the Samoa Financial Intelligence Unit and the licensed agent's lawful information requests
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Samoa AML/CFT regime: punitive fines against the IC, asset-freeze orders, mandatory reporting by the agent, and potential revocation of the agent's license if the agent facilitated the breach
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and the designated compliance officer are personally prosecutable; imprisonment of 2 to 10 years; travel bans pending resolution; reputational damage bars future banking relationships

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Late or non-filing of the annual return, non-payment of annual government fees, or failure to maintain the licensed registered agent for any continuous period
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Per-month late filing penalties and surcharges under the International Companies (Fees) Regulations; automatic striking-off after persistent default; contracts signed thereafter are unenforceable by the IC
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors personally liable for restoration fees and wind-up costs; personal guarantee exposures crystallize where the director signed as agent of a struck-off company; the company's separate personality is effectively dissolved

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Concealing the controlling person from the registered agent's CRS beneficial-ownership reporting, or submitting a false tax-residence self-certification for the shareholder or director
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Penalties under Samoa's International Tax Transparency and CRS legislation; the registered agent must terminate the relationship and report; beneficial ownership data is automatically exchanged with the residence tax authority
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Personal fines for the controller and signatory; knowing false self-certification is a criminal offence in most residence jurisdictions; the corporate veil is pierced and the controller is assessed directly as the true taxpayer
